message: The other day, while organizing my go-bag, I stumbled upon a deck of old playing cards. It took me back to summers spent with my grandkids, laughing over games of rummy and war. 🌞 In a world filled with screens, it’s nice to remember that some of the best fun can be low-tech and simple. Plus, it’s a great way to bond and keep our minds sharp! What’s your favorite way to have fun without the gadgets?
